Active Lives Children and Young People — Somerset 2024/25

Annual data through 2024/25. Generated 2026-09-22.

Internal validation draft. These are weighted descriptive percentages, not verified replicas of Sport England tables. Confidence intervals and significance claims are intentionally absent pending verification of the survey-design method. Unapproved indicator weights are omitted and listed below. Check the Somerset geography across years before circulation.

Percentages use valid coded responses with a positive finite indicator weight. Counts are rounded only after calculation. Cells below 8 and complementary cells are suppressed; displayed counts are rounded to 5. These disclosure settings carry forward the old project convention and require confirmation against the prescribed guidance. A blank is never interpreted as zero participation.

CYP reliability review. Local results are screened for fewer than 150 eligible valid responses and fewer than three contributing schools. This diagnostic applies the thresholds to each displayed denominator, including subgroups, across all years; it is not a verified reproduction of the year-specific publication rules. Flags do not yet alter estimates or suppression. Passing these checks does not validate confidence intervals, phase/term coverage or historical comparability. See 2022/23 technical report, section 7.8.

Historical notes and data gaps

2020/21;2021/22 — fasbandf: Standard family-affluence comparisons are omitted for these years. An adjusted scale excluding holidays was used during the pandemic; it is not substituted for the standard scale here. 9533_active_lives_child_y7_2023-24_data_user_guide.pdf, Table 8: Family Affluence Scale.

2019/20;2020/21;2021/22;2022/23;2023/24 — disab_all_pop: The disability question was updated from 2019/20. Comparisons with earlier years should take the question change into account. 8898_active_lives_child_year_3_data_user_guide_2019-20.pdf, Summary of changes / disability measure.

2023/24 — gend3: The Year 7-11 gender question wording changed in 2023/24, including a non-binary option and prefer-to-self-describe wording. The supplied grouped GEND3 dictionary still labels category 3 as Other; the pipeline preserves that grouped coding. 9533_active_lives_child_y7_2023-24_data_user_guide.pdf, 1.2 School year 3-11 pupils and parents.

2023/24 — wt_gross: State and independent schools were weighted together for the first time in 2023/24. Use the supplied annual weight; a constant weight name does not imply an unchanged weighting method. 9533_active_lives_child_y7_2023-24_data_user_guide.pdf, 4.1 Weighting pupil and parent data.

all — wt_gross: This pipeline is configured for the supplied UK Data Service single-year main datasets, using wt_gross. It does not assume the wt_grossCCLA variable in the old scripts is an equivalent weight. 9533_active_lives_child_y7_2023-24_data_user_guide.pdf, 3.2 Key variables; 4.1 Weighting pupil and parent data.

2019/20 — voln_bc_pop: 2019/20 volunteering covers school years 5-11. VolN_bc_POP was verified in the directly shared SPSS file: 1 = Yes, 2 = No; -99, -98 and -91 are excluded as missing. The earlier dictionary-based availability gap has been resolved. 8898_active_lives_child_year_3_data_user_guide_2019-20.pdf, Questionnaire coverage; directly shared SPSS file labels and school-year cross-tabulation.

2019/20 — outdoor_bcd_overall: No 2019/20 outdoor-access estimates: all 89,303 records in the directly shared file are coded -92 (question not asked in this survey year or term). 8898_active_lives_child_year_3_data_user_guide_2019-20.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.

2019/20 — xcluster: Cluster field verified in the directly shared file: 89,303 records, no missing values, 1,341 distinct clusters. 8898_active_lives_child_year_3_data_user_guide_2019-20.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.

2020/21 — xcluster: Cluster field verified in the directly shared file: 86,828 records, no missing values, 1,348 distinct clusters. 8929_active_lives_child_year_4_data_user_guide_2020-21_v2.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.

2021/22 — lonely_c: Five-category loneliness response restored from the directly shared file. Codes 1-5 included; code 6 (Prefer not to say) and negative missing codes excluded. 9111_active_lives_child_y5_data_user_guide_2021-22_final_v1.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.

2021/22 — pl_easy_bc_sa_gr2: Exercise ease restored from the directly shared file. Codes 1-2 included; code 99 (Can't say) and negative missing codes excluded. 9111_active_lives_child_y5_data_user_guide_2021-22_final_v1.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.

2021/22 — onceawk_modplus_everywhere_gr_dance_ca170: Weekly dance participation restored from the directly shared file. Codes 1-2 included; negative missing codes excluded. 9111_active_lives_child_y5_data_user_guide_2021-22_final_v1.pdf, Directly shared SPSS file verification.
